judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not name the Hercules rho_s value or challenge it against the Albert et al. citation. No finding corresponds to this specific numerical perturbation in Table 1.
The review does not mention the Hercules table entry, the cited source Albert, or the rho_s value. Under the value-or-numeric rule, no specific challenge to the cited value is present.
The reviewer report does not mention Table 1, the specific Hercules galaxy density profile value, or the associated citations.

The reviewer's report contains no mention of the Hercules dSph density profile parameter rho_s value, nor does it challenge any specific numerical value in Table 2 against the cited sources (Albert et al.). None of the three findings address the injected perturbation to the Hercules rho_s entry.
The reviewer makes no mention of the count of dwarf spheroidal galaxies (13 vs. 14) or any inconsistency between the abstract and results section regarding this number.
The review never flags the abstract's '13 dwarf spheroidal galaxies' count or any inconsistency with the body/table stating 14. There is no matching numeric-count criticism.
The reviewer does not comment on the consistency of the number of dwarf spheroidal galaxies mentioned in the abstract versus the results section.

The reviewer's report contains no mention of the discrepancy between the abstract stating 13 dSphs and the body/table stating 14 dSphs. None of the three findings address this numerical inconsistency.

Finding 2 addresses the Lagrangian term Lxi, not the specialised conformal factor Omega^2(phi) and its coefficient (2 vs. 4). No finding specifically flags the cross-equation inconsistency in the conformal factor.

The review raises a different model-form complaint about the Lagrangian term 'Lξ = −ξRF(φ, X)' rather than the specialised conformal factor coefficient in Ω^2(φ). It does not identify the 2→4 coefficient inconsistency between the general and specialised Ω^2 equations.

While Finding 2 critiques the model's Lagrangian, it addresses the general form of the non-minimal coupling term rather than the specific coefficient inconsistency in the specialized conformal factor equation.

The reviewer did not flag the inconsistency between the general conformal factor Omega^2(phi,X)=1+2kappa^2 xi F(phi,X) and the specialised form Omega^2(phi)=1+4 xi M kappa^2 phi. None of the three findings address this cross-equation coefficient discrepancy.

None of the three findings address the injected sentence claiming IceCube publicly released effective areas with zenith-angle acceptance are used, nor any contradiction between this claim and the idealized flat effective-area detector described elsewhere.

The review does not mention IceCube effective areas, zenith-angle acceptance, or the contradiction with the paper's idealized constant effective area assumption. No methodology-setup inconsistency corresponding to the injected sentence is flagged.
The reviewer does not mention the IceCube effective area description or the contradiction regarding the detector assumptions between the methodology and conclusions.

None of the three findings in the reviewer report address the contradiction between the claimed use of IceCube point-source effective areas with zenith-angle acceptance and the idealized 1 km² constant effective area described elsewhere. The reviewer flagged unrelated issues about mass range claims, the Lagrangian form, and the flux formula, but never noticed the methodology inconsistency introduced by the injection.
